topic: A summer romance on holiday in Spain
brief: Latin pop crossover: English verses, and the chorus should switch to Spanish.
title: Hasta el Verano
style: Latin pop, 102 BPM, male and female vocal
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I met you on the beach in Málaga in June,
you laughed at my accent and you hummed a tune,
we danced till the bars put the chairs on the tables,
and the sky turned pink above the cables.

[Chorus]
Adiós, amor, hasta el verano,
nunca olvidaré tu mano,
adiós, amor, no llores más,
el año que viene volverás.

[Verse 2]
Now I'm back in grey old Manchester rain,
I keep your photo on my window pane,
I'm learning Spanish on my phone at night,
so next July I'll say it right.

[Chorus]
Adiós, amor, hasta el verano,
nunca olvidaré tu mano,
adiós, amor, no llores más,
el año que viene volverás.
